So we need to test that it returns whatever outputFormat returns when execution context is created. We can mock OutputFormat to capture node and context maybe. But OutputFormat is an interface? Then call schemaSpy.walk(node, outputFormat, true) and assert result equals "result". Also verify that the overloaded walk was called with same node and outputFormat and validate flag.
